metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience at least 45 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mount Isa and Townsville, Queensland, Australia - Date: January 27 to February 10, 2019 - Data source: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily rainfall data - Need to check if cumulative rainfall >= 45 cm (450 mm) for both regions or just the areas around them 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is precipitation data, no cloud masking needed - Simply sum daily rainfall over the period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid rainfall = accumulation >= 0 mm (can be 0 if truly no rain) - Invalid/Null = if data unavailable or NaN - Threshold: 450 mm = 45 cm - Answer: A if both regions >= 450 mm, B if either/both < 450 mm, C1 if no data found ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define regions: Mount Isa and Townsville, Queensland const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.4917, -20.7267]); // Mount Isa const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.7781, -19.2643]); // Townsville // Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-10'; // Load CHIRPS daily rainfall data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const size = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images available: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log("No CHIRPS data found for the date range."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check Mount Isa const mountIsaStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mountIsaValue = mountIsaStats.precipitation; console.log(`Mount Isa total rainfall (mm): ${mountIsaValue !== null ? mountIsaValue.toFixed(2) : 'NaN'}`); // Check Townsville const townsvilleStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const townsvilleValue = townsvilleStats.precipitation; console.log(`Townsville total rainfall (mm): ${townsvilleValue !== null ? townsvilleValue.toFixed(2) : 'NaN'}`); // Validation if (mountIsaValue === null || townsvilleValue === null || isNaN(mountIsaValue) || isNaN(townsvilleValue)) { console.log("Invalid/null rainfall values."); console.log("C3"); return; } const threshold = 450; // 45 cm = 450 mm const mountIsaMet = mountIsaValue >= threshold; const townsvilleMet = townsvilleValue >= threshold; console.log(`Mount Isa >= 450mm: ${mountIsaMet}`); console.log(`Townsville >= 450mm: ${townsvilleMet}`); // Both regions must meet the threshold if (mountIsaMet && townsvilleMet) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
